edits.new: Neither a subject nor the other node can supply a missing identity, role, purpose, state or other restriction. Distinguish who or what the information concerns from the properties or actions it describes. Sharing properties or actions does not establish a required identity or kind. If the parent restricts an entity or participant to a kind or a named individual, test whether the child admits those same properties or actions for an entity outside that restriction. An unspecified entity or participant does not inherit the parent's restriction.
edits.old: Neither a subject nor the other node can supply a missing role, purpose, state or other restriction.
